subject: math
description: Use the sphere volume formula in direct and contextual problems, with special attention to interpreting radius and diameter correctly.
learningObjectives: Identify the radius and diameter of a sphere from diagrams and word problems
Use V = 4/3 pi r cubed to find the volume of a sphere
Convert a given diameter to radius before substituting into the formula
Interpret sphere volume answers in cubic units and contextual situations
Avoid the common error of cubing the diameter instead of the radius
prerequisites: Recognize radius and diameter in circles and spheres
Evaluate powers such as r cubed
Multiply fractions, decimals, and pi approximations
